reviewReason: Compile the diagnostic-only bounded original-core delta decoder and verify the fixed real graph; no runtime admission or signed qualification.

definition.name: Bounded reconstruction and fixed graph source proof

steps.name: Recreate the original-core delta and execute bounded Rust controls
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-original-delta"
catalog=crates/latent-component-threading/src/rust_catalogue
python3 -B tools/rust_original_delta.py --original "$catalog/combined-original-core.wasm" --base "$catalog/combined-final-component.wasm" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-original-delta/reconstructed.bin" | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-original-delta/generator.log"
cmp "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-original-delta/reconstructed.bin" "$catalog/combined-original-delta.bin"
cargo test --locked -p latent-component-threading --lib --features rust-http-combined-preview-diagnostic rust_original_delta::tests:: -- --nocapture 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-original-delta/tests.log"
grep -F 'test rust_original_delta::tests::fixed_real_delta_reconstructs_and_still_requires_full_source_proof ... ok' "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-original-delta/tests.log"
grep -F 'test rust_original_delta::tests::malformed_ranges_lengths_commands_and_trailing_data_fail_closed ... ok' "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-original-delta/tests.log"
grep -F 'test rust_original_delta::tests::fixed_graph_roundtrips_final_section_and_rejects_nonfinal_or_forged_material ... ok' "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-original-delta/tests.log"

steps.name: Retain bounded diagnostic outputs including failures
